Interesting facts
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Savanna was worth 129,000 crystals and was obtainable at the rank of Brigadier.
Savana's garage description was also changed on July 14, 2016 to reflect the Paint Separation Update.
Legacy paint description:
A paint that works well against Smoky and provides good protection against Railgun and Ricochet. Works well with mid to long-range battles. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
